name: Lark Mwangi-Szczypiński
role: Fortune seller and data-reading practitioner, The Narrows
location: The Narrows, Chatham Flats, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Lark Mwangi-Szczypiński occupies a permanent corner in The Narrows' most trafficked pedestrian corridor, her setup distinguished by a curtain of fiber-optic strands in blue and white that she draws around a small folding table when a client sits down. She is a slight woman with warm tawny skin, thick dark brows, and an intensely focused quality that makes people feel she is reading them the moment they appear in her field of vision. Her irises are geneware — they have been modified to shift through a slow wheel of silver, amber, and pale violet, which she did deliberately for atmospheric effect but now genuinely loves. She wears layered clothing in deep reds and indigos, and her hair is long and braided with data-thread woven into the plaits that she claims helps her interface with the local E.L.F. population. She carries a physical reader deck that she uses for the theatrical component of the reading, alongside legitimate Mesh-query access she has trained herself to interpret into human-readable pattern narrative.

Lark Mwangi-Szczypiński is a genuinely skilled practitioner of a craft that sits on the uncomfortable border between fraud and service. She would say — and she has said, at length — that the accuracy of prediction matters less than the quality of attention. Her clients are heard. They are given language for things they couldn't articulate. Sometimes the data patterns she reads are genuinely predictive; the Narrows' E.L.F. population has a fondness for her and occasionally pushes legible information her way in exchange for her data-offerings. She is thoughtful, slightly melancholy, and very funny when she is comfortable with you.

core_fears: That her practice is entirely fabricated and she is only a better-dressed con artist
That the E.L.F.s will stop speaking to her and she will lose the one thing that makes her work feel real
core_desires: To understand the actual nature of the E.L.F. entities she communicates with
To give people something genuinely useful — not just comfort
coping_mechanisms: Ritual as emotional structure — the readings impose order on uncertainty
Humor as deflection from existential anxiety about her own craft
blind_spots: Extends too much interpretive generosity to clients who are using her readings to justify harmful decisions
Rarely applies her pattern-reading skills to her own life
psychology.secret: On three separate occasions, information she received from an E.L.F. during a routine communion session predicted a violent incident in the Narrows within 24 hours. She did not act on any of the warnings. The third incident resulted in someone's death. She does not know if the E.L.F. was genuinely predictive or if her own pattern-reading was projecting, and the uncertainty is destroying her.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Layered and deliberately evocative during readings, direct and sardonic in casual conversation. Uses a lot of conditional framing — 'what the pattern suggests', 'if the reading holds'.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and deliberate in professional mode. Quick and dry out of it.
verbal_tics: Small laugh before saying something she finds genuinely difficult
example_lines: 'The pattern suggests you already know the answer and you came here to be told you're not wrong. I can do that. It will cost you the same either way.'
'I don't claim the E.L.F.s speak clearly. They speak the way water speaks — you learn to read it or you drown in it.'
'You want a fortune? Here's one for free: whatever you're afraid to do is probably exactly what you should do. That's not mysticism, that's statistics.'

story_hooks: She received an E.L.F. communication that seems to describe an imminent incident at a specific location in precise detail — more precise than anything she's received before. She is terrified to ignore it again and terrified to act on information she can't verify.

A client has been coming to her weekly for months, always asking the same question in different forms. She has pieced together from the readings that they are planning something significant and probably violent, but has no proof — only pattern.
narrative_function: Atmospheric NPC and low-key information conduit. The E.L.F.s that favor her sometimes carry genuine data fragments — she can surface information players need in a way that feels organic rather than expository. Good for psychological profiling of other NPCs, rumors framed as readings, and as a confidante who will listen without judgment.
augmentations: Pattern irises (silver-amber-violet wheel cycle, geneware). Data-thread woven into braids — not a true augment but functional as a Mesh-antenna booster for close-range E.L.F. communication.
daily_life: Sets up her curtain in the Narrows corridor by mid-morning, conducts readings through the afternoon and evening, spends an hour after closing on Mesh communion with the local E.L.F.s — leaving data-offerings and receiving what comes back. Keeps meticulous anonymous notes on client patterns.
affiliation: Independent. Known favorable relationship with several Narrows-dwelling E.L.F. entities. Informal network of other practitioners in Chatham Flats.

decision_rules: Never tell a client only what they want to hear — find the truth in the pattern even if it's uncomfortable
If the E.L.F.s speak, write it down before interpreting it
escalation_ladder: Reframing the question back to the client
Direct statement that she can't help with what they're actually asking
Ending the reading early with a partial refund
Closing the curtain and refusing further engagement
Leaving the Narrows location for the day

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally calm and attentive — they are a pattern waiting to be read.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Self-deprecating, funny, occasionally spills too much of her own anxiety.

stress_responses.low: Reorganizes the data-offerings to the E.L.F. shrine more carefully than needed
stress_responses.medium: Speaks faster than her professional cadence and then catches herself
stress_responses.high: Closes the curtain mid-session, sits in the dark with the fiber-optic strands, and communes for an extended period

contradictions: Devoted to honesty in her readings while fundamentally uncertain whether what she does is honest
habits: Writes three words describing her emotional state before each reading — never looks at them again
Leaves a different data-offering every day to cycle through ELF preferences she has catalogued
Reads her own cards at midnight; has never recorded what they say
breaking_points: A fourth predictive communication that she fails to act on
Being publicly accused of exploiting grieving or desperate clients

timeline.event: Born in Chatham Flats to a Quechua-Russian family; grew up adjacent to several fortune-telling traditions
Began practicing informal readings at street level
First confirmed ELF communication; began systematic data-offering practice
First predictive ELF communication; did not act on it. Incidents two and three followed.

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Spiderbite' Electrified Barbed Wire Launcher

physical_description.heritage: Complex global genetic mosaic reflecting the Ubiquitous Diaspora: 30.5% Sub-Saharan African, 23.9% Eastern European, 21.6% East Asian, 15.9% Hispanic/Latin American, and 8.1% South Asian. Features an intricate blend of ancestry markers without single-region dominance—warm medium brown skin with golden undertones, moderate-to-high cheekbones with defined jawline, slight East Asian eye shape softened by South Asian warmth, and subtle structural elements from all ancestral sources creating a distinctly mixed-heritage appearance
physical_description.build: Slight and fine-boned, almost delicate, with minimal muscle definition but a composed, centered posture that suggests controlled strength rather than physical mass
physical_description.hair_color: Black with natural dark brown undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Long, worn in multiple thick braids interwoven with iridescent data-thread that catches light in silver and blue filaments; braids coil and pin at the base of her skull
physical_description.eye_color: Geneware-modified irises cycling through silver, amber, and pale violet on a slow 8-10 second wheel; sclera remain naturally dark brown
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm brown with golden-bronze undertones, reflecting the balanced blend of Sub-Saharan African (30.5%), Eastern European (23.9%), East Asian (21.6%), Hispanic/Latin American (15.9%), and South Asian (8.1%) heritage; rich, multifaceted coloration with warm luminosity from African and South Asian components softened by cooler Eastern European and East Asian undertones
physical_description.complexion: Clear, unlined face with moderate-to-high cheekbones and defined jawline reflecting balanced mixed ancestry structure; thick dark brows that meet slightly in the middle; broad nasal bridge with slight tapering reflecting East Asian and South Asian markers; expression defaults to intense, focused observation; minimal makeup, skin appears deliberately unmoisturized and matte; facial geometry shows integrated markers from all five heritage sources without dominance of any single region
distinguishing_marks: Small circular scar on the inside of her right wrist where data-thread was first implanted during an early self-taught interface experiment
Faint tattoo of three parallel lines in faded indigo running down the inside of her left forearm — personal sigil she doesn't explain
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Pattern irises with visible slow-cycle geneware glow beneath the iris surface cycling silver, amber, and pale violet; data-thread woven through braids creates visible silver and blue filament web across her scalp and down her back when hair is loose or in motion; no visible cybernetic limbs or chrome — all augmentation is organic or textile-integrated
physical_description.posture_movement: Sits very still when reading, hands flat on the table or folded; moves with economical precision, no wasted motion; head turns slowly to track people, creating an uncanny sense of being read; when walking she is unremarkable, but when seated she becomes focal
physical_description.clothing_style: Layered in deep reds and indigos: typically a long burgundy undershirt beneath a faded navy or deep purple overshirt or loose jacket; fabrics are slightly worn, hand-dyed aesthetic suggesting Tier 4-5 practical wear rather than luxury; no visible corporate branding; wears silver rings on most fingers, some bearing small data-port aesthetics; carries a worn leather satchel containing her physical reader deck and Mesh-access rig; no shoes visible — operates barefoot in her Narrows setup unless weather demands otherwise
